course_description: This course deals with advanced game programming with a strong focus on developing good programming skills, design patterns, and practical problem-solving. The course will have a special provision on modality, pacing, pedagogy, assessment type, communication, and feedback based on the national, regional, provincial, city, and institutional guidelines for safety amidst disasters and pandemics. Hence, this class shall be delivered in both an online and offline/module-based approach. This course is also compliant with Outcomes-Based Education (OBE) and 21st Century Learning Design (21CLD) frameworks.
